text:
Priya: Hey team, our customers started seeing a bunch of 504/502s from the /v1/rerank endpoint around 09:10 UTC. p95 latency shot up and the client SDK is retrying which looks like a retry storm. We haven't changed model or infra on our side, using SDK v1.8.2. Can someone help triage?

Alicia: Sorry you're hitting this, Priya — can you share request IDs, app_id, and a small repro (payload + curl) if possible? Also how many candidates are you sending per request?

Priya: app_id=acme-42, request ID samples: req-8f7a, req-8f8b, req-8f9c. We send variable candidate lists but saw a spike when we pushed a job with ~500 candidates per request. Quick payload sample: 

```json
{
  "query": "best hotels in portland",
  "candidates": ["cand1","cand2",..."cand500"],
  "top_k": 10
}
```

Curl we used: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d @payload.json 
  --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30
```

Alicia: thanks. infra-bot just posted a notify: 

infra-bot: [09:12:18 UTC] alert: routing-gateway: p95 latency spike for /v1/rerank (2.1s) concurrent queued requests increased by 3.8x in region us-west-2

Tom: can you paste the exact gateway response body for one of the 502s/504s? Also do you see repeated request IDs (retries) from the client?

Priya: here's a raw 502 response we captured: 

```json
{
  "error": "Bad Gateway",
  "message": "upstream timeout",
  "request_id": "req-8f8b"
}
```

Priya: And yes, SDK retry logs show immediate backoff x3, then exponential, so we did get a bunch of retries during the incident window.

Javier: from runtime side, early suspicion: KV cache saturation + unbounded prefetch for large candidate lists can push worker queue depth beyond low-latency pools. That plus continuous batching under high QPS will amplify p95. Any chance these requests set large batch sizes or turned on aggressive prefetch?

Priya: we didn't change prefetch flags explicitly — using defaults via SDK v1.8.2. But we did push a campaign that sent many concurrent requests with 400–600 candidates each.

Sasha: oncall here — can we get a tracing snippet from the gateway for one of the failing request_ids? Need the route hops: gateway -> rerank-proxy -> runtime-pool. If runtime returned 5xx, include worker logs.

Alicia: Priya, can you run one failing req with `X-Request-Id` and share the header logs? Also, please try a quick repro: limit candidates to 100 and see if errors reproduce.

Priya: repro attempt attached (reduced candidates to 100) — succeeded, p95 ~450ms and no 5xx. When I push 500 candidates we hit 502 within ~200ms of start.

Javier: that aligns with KV inflation hypothesis. Logs from the node during the spike: 

```
[09:11:23] worker-23 ERROR UpstreamError: no free worker (queue_depth=256, max_workers=200)
[09:11:23] proxy-7 WARN request_latency=2123ms route=/v1/rerank status=504 request_id=req-8f8b
[09:11:23] runtime INFO kvcache.get keys_prefetched=512 duration=180ms
[09:11:24] autoscaler INFO scale_event: queued_jobs=180 -> scale_up
```

Javier: suggestion: temporarily disable aggressive prefetching and throttle per-request candidate limit at the gateway to 200 while we patch runtime to better reject oversized requests earlier. Also add circuit-breaker to avoid retry amplification.

Tom: I'll check gateway config and in-flight concurrency slots. Quick mitigation: enable 429-based throttle for >250 candidates and raise gateway upstream timeout to 45s for active maintenance window to avoid client-triggered retry storms. Also lift worker pool by +20% now.

Alicia: I've asked Priya to limit candidates to 200 and to pause concurrent campaign bursts for 15 minutes. Also notified account team. Priya confirmed they can throttle.

Max: product here — need to inform customer about expected behavior and root cause once identified. Also flag this for SDK release notes: default retry/backoff behavior combined with large candidate payloads can exacerbate backend saturation.

Sasha: action items captured: 
- ENG-Runtime (Javier) to add early validation: reject payloads >300 candidates with 400 and give guidance.
- ENG-SRE (Tom) to add temporary throttle rule and scale workers + circuit-breaker.
- Support (Alicia) to update customer and verify mitigation (Priya).
- Product (Max) to add SDK guidance and consider default retry tuning.

Alicia: marking as escalated -> incident-2521, assigning to eng-runtime. Will follow up in 15m with status. :thumbsup:

Priya: thanks all — after limiting to 200 the errors cleared. We'll coordinate with you for final root cause postmortem.

Tom: note for postmortem: correlate candidate list sizes with runtime queue depth and SDK versions. Capture any recent SDK rollout timestamps and gate those changes in the postmortem.

Javier: I'll start a small reproduction harness that sends 500-candidate requests at 200 qps into a staging runtime and capture KV cache metrics + worker saturation. Will drop findings in the incident doc.

infra-bot: [09:17:40 UTC] incident created: incident-2521 (assigned: eng-runtime)

Max: good. Let's also consider a quick patch for retry headers so clients can opt-out of retries on 5xx for rerank, if reasonable.

Alicia: closing thread for now, will post postmortem link in incident once available.
